full_judgment: 2. Plaintiffs 1 to 3 filed the suit for partition of the suit properties. There were some applicants who prayed for allotment of shares. Defendant no. 3 alone contested the suit contending, inter alia, that the suit was bad for defect of parties and barred by limitation. At the time of trial only two issues were pressed; whether the documents of the contesting defendant were fraudulent or not, and what would be the respective shares of the claimants.
